description: Ask the user to sign in to a site on their BAMF Cloud computer. The user types their own password and two-step code in the live view; BAMF never types credentials. Returns the exact BAMF chat message that opens the sign-in; the chat waits for the signed-in page, then continues.

site.description: Site or sign-in link, e.g. amazon.com or https://connect.bamf.com/login.

name: bamf.request_login
